lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

The removal and cleanup of bike lanes along Bloor Street West in Etobicoke is now officially complete, Ontario Transportation Minister Prabmeet Sarkaria announced Friday morning, The Canadian Press reports.

Christa Pike said Friday that she remains in constant pain and struggles to speak a month after surviving a lethal injection in Tennessee, a failure she blames on “incompetence,” The Associated Press reports.

Pope Leo XIV has become the first pope to vote in a U.S. general election, casting a mail-in ballot in a contest that will decide America’s future as the Trump era slowly comes to an end, The Associated Press reports.
Russian investigative newspaper Novaya Gazeta says it is shutting down after ‘co-ordinated campaign’, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
